notes.title: Demo Update 2: Gameplay & Fixes
notes.content:
Listen up soldiers!

Another update was pushed to the demo, improving gameplay and overall playability.

[b]Changes:[/b]

- Diagonal movement now uses correct acceleration

- Improved camera behaviour

- Reloading an already loaded gun is no longer possible

- Improved grenade UI visibility

- Improved numerous weapon effects

- Added Tooltips

- Rebalanced missions

- Added turret

[b]The game plays a lot smoother now. Enjoy![/b]


Stay tuned for more updates!

[i]Meister Palpus[/i]

tags.balance_change: - Diagonal movement now uses correct acceleration
